title: Dasakam 30 — Vāmanāvatāram
description: Bali’s rise drives the Devas to seek refuge; Aditi’s payovrata brings Vamana, who travels to Bali’s sacrifice and receives the sacred foot-washing water.
translation_note: No vetted stanza translation supplied. Caption commentary for stanzas 1–10 is preserved as supplied; caption #10 sits in the raw 010.jpg section and has no photo of its own.

stanzas.sanskrit:
शक्रेण सम्यति हतोऽपि बलिर्महात्मा
शुक्रेण जीविततनुः क्रतुवर्धितोष्मा ।
विक्रान्तिमान् भयनिलीनसुरां त्रिलोकीं
चक्रे वशे स तव चक्रमुखादभीतः ॥ ३०-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śakreṇa samyati hato’pi balirmahātmā
śukreṇa jīvitatanuḥ kratuvardhitoṣmā |
vikrāntimān bhayanilīnasurāṁ trilokīṁ
cakre vaśe sa tava cakramukhādabhītaḥ || 30-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
The magnanimous Bali was killed by Lord Indra. 
 Bali came back to life & grew in power because of Sukracharya’s  'vishwajit' sacrifice and conquered three worlds. Devas hid themselves in the fear of being killed by Bali.

stanzas.sanskrit:
पुत्रार्तिदर्शनवशाददितिर्विषण्णा
तं काश्यपं निजपतिं शरणं प्रपन्ना ।
त्वत्पूजनं तदुदितं हि पयोव्रताख्यं
सा द्वादशाहमचरत्त्वयि भक्तिपूर्णा ॥ ३०-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
putrārtidarśanavaśādaditirviṣaṇṇā
taṁ kāśyapaṁ nijapatiṁ śaraṇaṁ prapannā |
tvatpūjanaṁ taduditaṁ hi payovratākhyaṁ
sā dvādaśāhamacarattvayi bhaktipūrṇā || 30-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Aditi, mother of Devas, seeing the sad plight of her sons, requested Kashyapa, her husband to help. He asked her to do payovrata worship for twelve days to Bhagwan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तस्यावधौ त्वयि निलीनमतेरमुष्याः
श्यामश्चतुर्भुजवपुः स्वयमाविरासीः ।
नम्रां च तामिह भवत्तनयो भवेयं
गोप्यं मदीक्षणमिति प्रलपन्नयासीः ॥ ३०-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tasyāvadhau tvayi nilīnamateramuṣyāḥ
śyāmaścaturbhujavapuḥ svayamāvirāsīḥ |
namrāṁ ca tāmiha bhavattanayo bhaveyaṁ
gopyaṁ madīkṣaṇamiti pralapannayāsīḥ || 30-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Aditi completed the worship in twelve days with sincerity and devotion. Bhagwan appeared before her with four arms and said that Bhagwan himself will be born as a son to them, but to keep it a secret.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वं काश्यपे तपसि सन्निदधत्तदानीं
प्राप्तोऽसि गर्भमदितेः प्रणुतो विधात्रा ।
प्रासूत च प्रकटवैष्णवदिव्यरूपं
सा द्वादशीश्रवणपुण्यदिने भवन्तम् ॥ ३०-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvaṁ kāśyape tapasi sannidadhattadānīṁ
prāpto’si garbhamaditeḥ praṇuto vidhātrā |
prāsūta ca prakaṭavaiṣṇavadivyarūpaṁ
sā dvādaśīśravaṇapuṇyadine bhavantam || 30-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: On the auspicious day of Dwadashi and Thrivonam Nakshatram together, Bhagwan was born to Goddess Aditi with Chaturbhujam, sanku chakra, gadha, padmam.

stanzas.sanskrit:
पुण्याश्रमं तमभिवर्षति पुष्पवर्षै-
-र्हर्षाकुले सुरगणे कृततूर्यघोषे ।
बद्ध्वाञ्जलिं जय जयेति नुतः पितृभ्यां
त्वं तत् क्षणे पटुतमं वटुरूपमाधाः ॥ ३०-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
puṇyāśramaṁ tamabhivarṣati puṣpavarṣai-
-rharṣākule suragaṇe kṛtatūryaghoṣe |
baddhāñjaliṁ jaya jayeti nutaḥ pitṛbhyāṁ
tvaṁ tat kṣaṇe paṭutamaṁ vaṭurūpamādhāḥ || 30-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The Devas in great joy were showering flowers on Bhagwan and were blowing trumpets. Goddess Aditi & Kashyapa were praising Bhagwan with folded hands & just then Bhagwan took on the form of a talented handsome Brahmachaarin Vaamana.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावत्प्रजापतिमुखैरुपनीय मौञ्जी-
-दण्डाजिनाक्षवलयादिभिरर्च्यमानः ।
देदीप्यमानवपुरीश कृताग्निकार्य-
-स्त्वं प्रास्थिथा बलिगृहं प्रकृताश्वमेधम् ॥ ३०-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvatprajāpatimukhairupanīya mauñjī-
-daṇḍājinākṣavalayādibhirarcyamānaḥ |
dedīpyamānavapurīśa kṛtāgnikārya-
-stvaṁ prāsthithā baligṛhaṁ prakṛtāśvamedham || 30-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Father Kashyapa performed upanyanam to Bhagwan and offered sacred thread, stick, deer skin, and a garland of beads. Bhagwan performed the rites with the sacred fire and departed for the house of Bali where the Ashvamedha Yanjya was being performed.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गात्रेण भाविमहिमोचितगौरवं प्रा-
-ग्व्यावृण्वतेव धरणीं चलयन्नयासीः ।
छत्रं परोष्मतिरणार्थमिवादधानो
दण्डं च दानवजनेष्विव सन्निधातुम् ॥ ३०-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gātreṇa bhāvimahimocitagauravaṁ prā-
-gvyāvṛṇvateva dharaṇīṁ calayannayāsīḥ |
chatraṁ paroṣmatiraṇārthamivādadhāno
daṇḍaṁ ca dānavajaneṣviva sannidhātum || 30-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Vaamana held the umbrella as though he wanted to mask the might of the asuras and carried stick as if to punish the asuras. Bhagwan’s body weight shook the earth.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तां नर्मदोत्तरतटे हयमेधशाला-
-मासेदुषि त्वयि रुचा तव रुद्धनेत्रैः ।
भास्वान् किमेष दहनो नु सनत्कुमारो
योगी नु कोऽयमिति शुक्रमुखैः शशङ्के ॥ ३०-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāṁ narmadottarataṭe hayamedhaśālā-
māseduṣi tvayi rucā tava ruddhanetraiḥ |
bhāsvān kimeṣa dahano nu sanatkumāro
yogī nu ko’yamiti śukramukhaiḥ śaśaṅke || 30-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: As Vamana approached the banks of Narmada, his radiance blindfolded Shukrachaarya and other sages and they wondered who he could be?, is he the Sun or Agni or Sage Sanatkumara?!.

stanzas.sanskrit:
आनीतमाशु भृगुभिर्महसाभिभूतै-
-स्त्वां रम्यरूपमसुरः पुलकावृताङ्गः ।
भक्त्या समेत्य सुकृती परिषिच्य पादौ
तत्तोयमन्वधृत मूर्धनि तीर्थतीर्थम् ॥ ३०-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ānītamāśu bhṛgubhirmahasābhibhūtai-
-stvāṁ ramyarūpamasuraḥ pulakāvṛtāṅgaḥ |
bhaktyā sametya sukṛtī pariṣicya pādau
tattoyamanvadhṛta mūrdhani tīrthatīrtham || 30-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: All the sages welcomed Vamana in to the yagnakootam. Mahabali seeing the young Brahmin in full radiance, was happy to receive him and washed his feet with holy waters and sprinkled that water on his head. knowing that he is Bhagwan himself.

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रह्लादवंशजतया क्रतुभिर्द्विजेषु
विश्वासतो नु तदिदं दितिजोऽपि लेभे ।
यत्ते पदाम्बु गिरिशस्य शिरोभिलाल्यं
स त्वं विभो गुरुपुरालय पालयेथाः ॥ ३०-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prahlādavaṁśajatayā kratubhirdvijeṣu
viśvāsato nu tadidaṁ ditijo’pi lebhe |
yatte padāmbu giriśasya śirobhilālyaṁ
sa tvaṁ vibho gurupurālaya pālayethāḥ || 30-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Lord Shiva holds the Ganga which flows from Bhagwan’s feet. Since, Bali came in Prahlada dynasty, he did sacrifices, offered respect to Brahmins, Bhattathiri says Bali must have been blessed to receive this holy water on his head.
Bhattathiri prays to Guruvayoorappa to protect everyone.
